name: Artbucket
use_label: Brand asset manager for people & agents
one_liner: Open-source brand asset management that gives people, AI agents and code the same answer about logos, rules and rights.

text.why: Which logo is current, and may this photo run in paid social in Germany? Artbucket keeps assets, rules, rights and releases together and answers 'May I use this?'.
text.take: The web app uses only the public API, so anything it does can be scripted.
build: A web app, MCP server, REST API, CLI and Git share the same data. npx artbucket check reports an expired licence and the replacement asset, and agents connect over MCP with a chosen permission (Suggest, Read or Edit).

who.role: Marketing and design teams who manage brand assets and usage rights.

start.text: Run it yourself with pnpm and Docker, or use the Artbucket Cloud link in the README.

caveat: AGPL-3.0: a modified version offered as a service must share its source. A new project with 5 stars; the hosted Cloud pricing was not checked.

license.scope_text: Release source if you redistribute or host it as a service.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: The Artbucket library: image, PDF and video cards in a 'Big Buck Bunny' collection with Type, Tags, Status and License filters.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
null in the JSON means not observed — never zero. The Markdown writes [unconfirmed] for it.
